## What needs the owner

How sure each use case's text is (its Open Points) and the first question only the owner can answer. **high**: restates decisions taken; **medium**: extrapolated from the brief and the catalogue; **low**: a first guess to extend.

| Use case | Confidence | First open question |
|---|---|---|
| [UC-W1](../use-cases/UC-W1-vault-work.md) | medium | Does "works and tasks, not projects" rename `01 Projects/` and the project files for every vault, or is it one colleague's local name for the same shape? |
| [UC-W2](../use-cases/UC-W2-life-coach.md) | low | What does "realise them" mean: check-ins on a schedule, or only when the owner asks? |
| [UC-W3](../use-cases/UC-W3-secretary.md) | low | May the secretary write to the calendar after a yes, or only propose? |
| [UC-W4](../use-cases/UC-W4-planning-horizons.md) | high / low | What shape has the life horizon ("including how I want to die"), and how often is it reviewed? |
| [UC-W5](../use-cases/UC-W5-companion-on-the-go.md) | low | Which runtime on the move: a phone app, a chat bot, or a hosted agent? |
| [UC-W6](../use-cases/UC-W6-devops-engineer.md) | high | The daily review is the `ops-watch` check-up: a fixed list of checks, posted in `#infra-alerts` and on a pinned GitHub issue (`service-reliability`, `references/daily-checkup.md`). |
| [UC-W7](../use-cases/UC-W7-sales-assistant.md) | high | One agent with modes (DEC-1): run types are modes of one job, not separate agents. |
| [UC-W8](../use-cases/UC-W8-proposals-and-offers.md) | high / medium | Which PDF toolchain and template carry the company style (LaTeX on Overleaf, as UC-W16, or another)? |
| [UC-W9](../use-cases/UC-W9-qualify-leads-and-partnerships.md) | medium | Does the five-P skill from the sales package own qualification for UC-W7, UC-W9 and UC-W10 (one method, three variants), or does `add-commercial-chain` own it? |
| [UC-W10](../use-cases/UC-W10-qualify-prospect.md) | medium | Is this the same agent as UC-W9 (one qualification method, three variants) or a mode of the sales assistant (UC-W7)? |
| [UC-W11](../use-cases/UC-W11-market-research.md) | low | Which markets come first (sectors, B2B or B2G, geographies)? |
| [UC-W12](../use-cases/UC-W12-commercial-structure-and-offer.md) | low | Does the commercial structure replace, extend or sit above the engagement stages and the services catalogue already in the repo (parked as HQ-08.1, the commercial layer)? |
| [UC-W13](../use-cases/UC-W13-negotiation-partner.md) | low | `semantic-consulting-coach` already covers negotiation decisions in the consulting domain: extend it, or build a separate partner for all commercial and business situations? |
| [UC-W14](../use-cases/UC-W14-business-coach.md) | medium | Should `business-coach` reuse `semantic-consulting-coach`'s method and modes, or be a separate coach with its own? |
| [UC-W15](../use-cases/UC-W15-internal-communication.md) | low | Which audience and channel for each cadence (email, chat, Odoo), and who receives the monthly executive briefing? |
| [UC-W16](../use-cases/UC-W16-contracts-and-ndas.md) | low | Which templates, contract types and governing laws come first? |
| [UC-W17](../use-cases/UC-W17-graphic-designer.md) | low | Where is the brand guide today, and is it complete enough to check against? |
| [UC-W18](../use-cases/UC-W18-programming-team-lead.md) | high | The owner's phrase is "team lead of developers, architects, designers, product developers and modellers": should one lead agent dispatch the others, or does the developer stay the orchestrator as today? |
| [UC-W19](../use-cases/UC-W19-system-architect.md) | high | Where do the architecture artefacts live in a project (`docs/architecture/`, Antora, Enterprise Architect), and does `project-setup` scaffold that place? |
| [UC-W20](../use-cases/UC-W20-conceptual-modeller.md) | high | Which of the new ideas from the recent talks should change this use case, and which belong in a new one? |
| [UC-W21](../use-cases/UC-W21-demo-builder.md) | low | Which stack and which demo domain come first, and who hosts the demo environments? |
